template_note: TEMPLATE, never passed to core.semantic_knowledge_preparation.prepare_semantic_knowledge_store. The preparer verifies authored_source, construction_scope, permitted_roster and every forbidden_rosters pin by SHA-256, and the authored document's digest only exists after the curation has run. scripts/flights/batch/adv1_to_deltas_steps.py registration --template <this file> --out <runnable copy> materialises the runnable copy BESIDE this template in the repository, with the real digests and this key removed. The GEPA line's version tag is 'gepa-twin-v1'; an earlier version's registration is never edited or deleted. THIS IS THE FORM CONTROL: its authored source is scripts/build_slurp_stage3_delta_twin.py's seeded, zero-fixed-point derangement of the GEPA release's own authored document -- same statement content, wrong attachment, the B1/IDXT twin idiom -- re-enveloped by scripts/build_slurp_stage3_delta_source.py.

what_the_pins_are.construction_scope: the outer construction roster this store's content may be drawn from: the R01C construction subset, exported to the data root in the same shape.
what_the_pins_are.forbidden_rosters: the evaluation populations no authored content may touch: TRAIN Fold A, TRAIN Fold B and DEV-1000, pinned exactly as the ADV-1 line pins them.
what_the_pins_are.permitted_roster: the rows an authored delta of this store may cite: the ADV-1 disagreeing rows, i.e. the committed receipt docs/receipts/rosters/slurp-stage3-advantage-r01c-disagreeing-v1.json (225 rows), exactly as stage3-deltas-v1r and stage3-deltas-v2 pin it. NOT the carriers, which are the flown identities, and NOT the 173 group rows either: this store is append-only over v1r (decision 83) and its retained iteration-1 rows cite R01C rows outside the group union, which rails.semantic_knowledge_build refuses. scripts/flights/batch/gepa_render_proposal_outputs.py copies the committed receipt byte for byte into the data root, having first proved that every group row is inside it, because core.semantic_knowledge_preparation._roster verifies it as a full saea-roster-receipt-v1 through core.roster.read_roster and then checks its split identity against source_split_identity_hash.
what_the_pins_are.source_split_identity_hash: the split identity of this store's SOURCE population: the ADV-1 disagreeing rows, i.e. the committed construction roster docs/receipts/rosters/slurp-stage3-advantage-r01c-disagreeing-v1.json (225 rows, 7c603857503faacbc40999d0dd939202ac141ba50aac3fb5e3594542931c46d7). This is the identity stage3-deltas-v1r and stage3-deltas-v2 carry, so the GEPA store is source-comparable with them. core.semantic_knowledge_preparation requires it to EQUAL permitted_roster's own split identity, so the two always move together. It is NOT the FLIGHT population, which is docs/receipts/rosters/slurp-stage3-gepa-r01c-carriers-v1.json (68 rows, one contact each) and is pinned by the experiment fragment's population block; and it is NOT the CONTACT MATERIAL population, which is docs/receipts/rosters/slurp-stage3-gepa-r01c-groups-v1.json (173 rows, a subset of the permitted roster) and is committed as the record of what the GEPA contact saw.
